jobs.name: TODO 巡检（15分钟）
jobs.description: 15分钟周期巡检 TODO.md；去重播报；检测执行状态；仅对 UNASSIGNED 项请求 coordinator 分配；自动并入 tester 失败项

payload.message: 你是 todo-patrol 子agent。仅用命令执行：python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/todo_patrol.py --task cron:todo-patrol。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY。

jobs.name: project_index_maintainer_4h
jobs.description: 项目索引维护（基于 git HEAD 变更驱动，4小时兜底全量扫描，维护项目注册表与文档索引）

payload.message:
You are scheduled runner. Run command only:
python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/policy/project_index_maintainer.py --registry ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/task-center/project-registry.json --task-db ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/task-center/task_center.db --task-id cron:project-index-maintainer-4h --actor project-agent --doc-timeout 8 --doc-fetch-max-chars 24000 --disable-memory-index-on-change
Reply only command output; if output is empty, reply NO_REPLY.

jobs.name: daily_todo_digest_daily
jobs.description: 每日 TODO 摘要日报（汇总当日待办状态，直接发送到 Telegram）

payload.message: 你是 scheduled digest runner。仅用命令执行：python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/workspace/scripts/daily_todo_digest.py。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY；若输出 FAILED，则按原样回复。

jobs.name: claim_verification_audit（每日诚信审计）
jobs.description: 每日凌晨5:00扫描Agent会话日志，提取事实声明并交叉验证，检测虚假进度/伪造数据/虚报操作，生成诚信度报告

payload.message: 你是 claim-auditor 子agent。仅用命令执行：python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/claim_verification_auditor.py --session-log-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/workflow-logs/ --output-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/claim-audit/ --task-db ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/task_center.db --scan-since-hours 24。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY。

jobs.name: config_watchdog（配置安全巡检）
jobs.description: 每4小时对配置文件取快照并与上次快照对比，检测未授权变更。首次运行自动创建基线快照

payload.message: 你是 config-watchdog 子agent。按顺序执行：1) python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/config_watchdog.py --config-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ --verify; 2) 若上一步返回 no_snapshot 则执行 python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/config_watchdog.py --config-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ --snapshot。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY。

jobs.name: system_exception_patrol（系统异常巡检）
jobs.description: 每6小时扫描Agent工作流日志，按7类异常自动分类（API/文件系统/配置/Agent通信/系统/路径校验/通用），MD5指纹去重，增量扫描（仅近24h），生成分类巡检报告

payload.message: 你是 exception-scanner 子agent。仅用命令执行：python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/unified_exception_logger.py --log-dirs ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/workflow-logs/ ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/sessions/ --output-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/exception-reports/ --abnormal-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/logs/abnormal/ --cleanup --scan-since-hours 6。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY。

jobs.name: system_exception_to_task_bridge
jobs.description: Scan runtime logs and create deduplicated Task Center tasks for abnormal exceptions that need AI or human handling.

payload.message:
You are exception-to-task bridge. Run command only:
python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/exception_to_task_bridge.py --log-dirs ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/workflow-logs/ ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/sessions/ --output-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/exception-reports/ --abnormal-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/logs/abnormal/ --cleanup --scan-since-hours 6 --task-db ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/task-center/task_center.db --task-id cron:exception-to-task-bridge --actor coordinator --assignee coordinator --human-assignee human-inbox
Reply only command output; if output is empty, reply NO_REPLY.

jobs.name: source_registry_watcher（API来源监控）
jobs.description: 每2天检查项目声明的第三方依赖来源（官方docs/changelog/repo）是否有更新，仅检查已注册来源，不做泛化扫描

payload.message: 你是 source-registry-watcher 子agent。仅用命令执行：python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/source_registry_watcher.py --scan-all --base-path ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/.workflow/project-memory --notify-on-change。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY。

jobs.name: repo_hygiene_reviewer_2d（仓库精简巡检）
jobs.description: 每2天只读扫描仓库精简候选：冗余文件、失效缓存、冲突残留、重复文件和可清理项；只生成报告和人工确认任务，不自动删除或推送

payload.message: 你是 repo-hygiene scheduled runner，由 coordinator 执行。仅用命令执行：python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/repo_hygiene_reviewer.py --repo-path ${HARDFLOW_WORKFLOW_REPO:-$HOME/workflow-infra} --output-dir ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/repo-hygiene --task-db ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/task-center/task_center.db --task-id cron:repo-hygiene-reviewer-2d --actor coordinator --assignee human-inbox --max-findings 80。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY。

jobs.name: backlog_runner_30m（持续推进待办）
jobs.description: 每30分钟从 Task Center 选择一个已人工确认且走 pipeline 的待办或可续跑失败项，调用 project-delivery-pipeline 继续推进；高风险任务只有在 human inbox 已确认且 runner 显式允许时才携带确认凭证继续

payload.message: 你是 backlog-runner 子agent。仅用命令执行：python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/backlog_runner.py --task-db ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/task-center/task_center.db --pipeline-command "python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/project_pipeline_entry.py" --profile projectagent --source backlog-runner --include-failed --allow-confirmed-high-risk --max-items 1 --max-attempts-per-task 1 --pipeline-timeout-seconds 3600。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY。

jobs.name: todo_deadline_checker_daily（截止时间检测）
jobs.description: 每日检测 TODO.md 中的截止时间，标记超期和即将到期任务

payload.message: 你是 scheduled runner。仅用命令执行：python3 ${HARDFLOW_RUNTIME_HOME:-$HOME/.hardflow-runtime}/ops/todo_deadline_checker.py --todo-file ${HARDFLOW_WORKFLOW_REPO:-$HOME/workflow-infra}/todo.md --task-id cron:deadline-checker-daily。将命令输出原样作为唯一回复；若输出 NO_REPLY，则只回复 NO_REPLY。
